t_advice_summary_textbox.text: So the gnomes will appear in fixed pairs, one half of the pairs leads you to he bright forest, and one half takes you to the dark forest. Bright - orange, green blue and red. dark is the other colours - pink, purple, yellow and brown. You need to find out which forest has the largest amount of mushrooms and click the colour that correlates to that one. Also the gnomes appearance does not matter at all, just there hat colour! As well as this there is the points multiplier so you should focus during the 5x rounds.

vb_textbox.text: Hello. The advice I have is, the only important thing is the colour of the gnomes. Ignore all the other details like size appearance etc, just focus on the colours. So there are 2 forests; there is the bright forest with the red basket - the gnomes that take you there are the orange, green, red and blue gnomes. Then there is the dark forest with the yellow basket - the gnomes that take you there are the brown, pink, yellow and purple ones.Now the advice I was given before told me to find out which forest gives the most mushrooms and choose those colours so I tried to do that and I did okay. Although honestly it did just seem pretty random at times. Also the gnomes always come in set pairs, so its always orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and blue and purple. It is very hard to pay attention to every single one so don't even try, just focus on the ones that say 5x multiplier as they give way more mushrooms.
